components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one strong action in a surface.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 48px; border: 0; border-radius: 14px; padding: 12px 20px; background: var(--cobalt, #075cf5); color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 14px 28px -16px rgb(7 92 245 / 65%); font: 700 16px/1.2 Manrope, sans-serif; transition: background-color 200ms, box-shadow 200ms, transform 200ms; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: var(--cobalt-deep, #0047d7); } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #075cf5; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Language Toggle
components.css: .ds-language { display: inline-flex; min-width: 76px; min-height: 46px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; border: 1px solid rgb(16 24 77 / 12%); border-radius: 999px; background: #fff; color: #10184d; font: 750 14px/1.2 Manrope, sans-serif; } .ds-language svg { width: 18px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; } .ds-language:hover { border-color: rgb(16 24 77 / 24%); } .ds-language:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #075cf5; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Sky Routine Field
components.description: A broad Weekly choice with a soft asymmetric silhouette.
components.css: .ds-routine { display: flex; width: 100%; min-height: 108px; align-items: center; gap: 16px; border: 0; padding: 14px 18px 14px 14px; color: #10184d; font: 760 22px/1.2 Manrope, sans-serif; text-align: left; } .ds-routine-sky { border-radius: 42px 84px 28px 38px; background: #e3f3ff; } .ds-routine-icon { display: grid; width: 56px; height: 56px; place-items: center; border-radius: 50%; background: #fff; color: #075cf5; } .ds-routine-icon svg { width: 30px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-routine:hover { filter: saturate(1.04); } .ds-routine:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #075cf5; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Mint Routine Field
components.description: A broad Fortnightly choice with a distinct soft silhouette.
components.css: .ds-routine { display: flex; width: 100%; min-height: 108px; align-items: center; gap: 16px; border: 0; padding: 14px 18px 14px 14px; color: #10184d; font: 760 22px/1.2 Manrope, sans-serif; text-align: left; } .ds-routine-mint { border-radius: 52px 28px 72px 34px; background: #e5f7ef; } .ds-routine-icon { display: grid; width: 56px; height: 56px; place-items: center; border-radius: 50%; background: #fff; } .ds-routine-icon-mint { color: #118969; } .ds-routine-icon svg { width: 30px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-routine:hover { filter: saturate(1.04); } .ds-routine:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #075cf5; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Bottom Navigation
components.description: Three equal primary destinations with one clear active state.
components.html: HomeHistorySettings
components.css: .ds-nav { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); min-height: 78px; padding: 8px 12px; border-top: 1px solid rgb(16 24 77 / 8%); background: rgb(255 255 255 / 94%); } .ds-nav-item { position: relative; display: flex; min-height: 54px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 14px; color: #56628b; font: 650 12px/1.2 Manrope, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-item.ds-active { color: #075cf5; } .ds-nav-item.ds-active::before { position: absolute; top: -8px; width: 44px; height: 3px; border-radius: 999px; background: #075cf5; content: ""; } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: #10184d; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #075cf5; outline-offset: 4px; }

narrative.overview: Doubtfire is a fresh, light, and modern household utility. Familiar controls sit on an open white surface. Broad fields of sky, mint, and lilac give the product a clear style. The interface is direct and supportive. It gives people a calm place to start without scores, debt, or pressure. The layout uses a familiar app structure: a compact header, one clear opening action, a short Routine list, and fixed primary navigation on phones. Color makes each choice easy to identify. It does not report status or urgency.
keyCharacteristics: Broad color fields instead of a neutral card dashboard.
Deep navy type and cobalt actions on white or cool-ice surfaces.
Asymmetric soft corners and almost-flat depth.
Generous open space with compact, familiar controls.
Supportive copy with no competitive or warning-heavy language.

rules.name: The Color-Island Rule
rules.body: Use sky, mint, and lilac as broad navigable fields. Do not reduce them to small badges on white cards.

rules.name: The Coral Restraint Rule
rules.body: Coral is decorative and rare. Do not use it for warnings.

rules.name: The Short-Display Rule
rules.body: Keep display text short enough to stay clear at a tight line height. Use body styles for explanations.

rules.name: The Flat-First Rule
rules.body: Use color and spacing before adding a shadow. A shadow must explain a control or contained surface.

dos: Do use broad sky, mint, and lilac fields to organize the primary choices.
Do keep copy short, direct, supportive, and compatible with ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English.
Do use deep navy for readable hierarchy and cobalt for actions, focus, and active state.
Do keep motion small and optional. The still-life settle runs only when reduced motion is not requested.
Do adapt the composition at 760 px instead of scaling the phone layout.
donts: Don't build a neutral dashboard from many small white cards.
Don't show scores, percentages, denominators, task debt, competitive coaching, or warning-heavy states.
Don't use coral as a warning color.
Don't add shadows only for decoration.
Don't copy reference brands, logos, product claims, or device imagery.
